description: Doc-11 (P4/W4.1) per-domain RAG golden eval set. Expanded from the Phase B2.5 12-question set to a comprehensive per-domain corpus (~120 questions) proving 'the AI knows the system' across CLASSIC + NEW (device-programming, edge/orchestration, andon, maintenance/work-orders, predictive, energy, master-data/BOM, traceability/genealogy, AI-copilot/agent, anomaly, recipes, thresholds, api-keys, audit) + SELF-DESCRIPTION domains (route/nav/schema_table/module sourceTypes). Each item: {id, question, lang, domain, expectSourceContains[], expectKeywords[]}. recall@5 is a HIT when at least one of the top-5 retrieved chunks satisfies the expectation: its sourcePath contains any string in expectSourceContains (case-insensitive) OR its chunk text contains any keyword in expectKeywords. Every expectSourceContains substring was verified to exist as a real sourcePath in knowledge/chunks.jsonl (2170 chunks) so the gate stays meaningful.
